source_binding.policy: job-supplied owned copy; production /root/code/agent_flow is never a scored source root

vitest.reason: singleFork changes isolation and is only a config-level option on 1.6.1 (the CLI flag fails fast with CACError); only isolated one-worker forks are admitted for this profile

command.selectors: appended after the template as separate argv elements (vitest filename filters)

selectors.note: empty selection means the full suite; zero collected tests is an incomplete required check, never success

preparation.authority: npm owns the lifecycle; the job layer verifies generated outputs exist afterward and never runs the generator a second time

deadlines.status: proposed, conditional on three valid admission runs showing margin; full-suite runs may legitimately exceed this and need their own operation

isolation.sandbox: established bwrap recipe (unshare-pid/net/ipc/uts, cap-drop ALL) inside a uniquely named transient systemd unit
isolation.resource_mutex: none (single-sequence test execution; browser journeys are separate operations)

supports_coalescing.reason: disabled for the first slice by plan; exact in-flight coalescing is a later admitted feature

supports_reuse.reason: completed-pass reuse off until determinism and mutation fixtures pass

supports_incremental_report.reason: final vitest JSON report only; incremental JSONL events need separate admission

requires_external_state.reason: unit tests are offline; browser/server operations are separate profiles

notes: profile lifecycle authority stays with npm; the supervisor never bypasses pretest
reporter admission (JSON, optional JUnit) happens in checkpoint 3 calibration; both are marked unadmitted until then
